mechanism_narrative: The level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is negatively correlated with S&P 500 20-day forward returns. Higher FEDFUNDS levels predict negative returns.
failure_condition: The signal fails if 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS is above the 50th percentile, or if the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 200, it predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The signal fails if 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 200, or if the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of FEDFUNDS above 4.5% and CPIAUCSL above 200 predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: high inflation and tight monetary policy
failure_condition: The signal fails if 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5 AND CPIAUCSL > 200, or if the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion (defined by GDPC1 growth > 2% and UNRATE < 4.0%), a housing starts level (HOUST) below 2000 predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The signal fails if 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where the late-cycle expansion condition is met and HOUST < 2000, or if the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 4.0%, it predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The signal fails if 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE < 4.0, or if the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 110, it predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The signal fails if 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO < 110, or if the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Higher employment levels (PAYEMS) are positively correlated with S&P 500 5-day forward returns. Higher PAYEMS levels predict positive returns.
failure_condition: The signal fails if 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS is above the 50th percentile, or if the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When residential sales (RSAFS) exceed 350000, it predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The signal fails if 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where RSAFS > 350000, or if the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
